info.name: Job Portal API
info.description:
REST API for a job portal. Employers post jobs and review applications; candidates search jobs and apply. All paths use {{baseUrl}} and protected routes take a Bearer token.

Test accounts (password secret123): aarav@example.com and nisha@example.com are employers, riya@example.com and arjun@example.com are candidates. The login requests fill the token variables automatically. Create Job saves {{jobId}} and Apply to a Job saves {{applicationId}}. Close Job and Delete Job use their own job variables so the main flow stays intact.

The saved examples were captured from the running API, including the failure cases.

item.name: Applications
item.description: Candidates apply and withdraw. Employers review applications and move them through the allowed statuses.

request.description: Candidate only. Body: coverLetter (optional, max 2000 characters). A candidate can apply once per job and cannot apply to a closed job. Saves the application id to {{applicationId}}.

response.name: Get My Applications - 401 No Token

request.description: Job owner only. Returns applications with the candidate name and email. Add ?status=applied, shortlisted, rejected or hired to filter.

response.name: Get Applications of a Job - 200 With Data
Get Applications of a Job - 403 Another Employer
Get Applications of a Job - 200 Filtered By Status

request.description: Job owner only. Allowed moves: applied -> shortlisted or rejected, shortlisted -> hired or rejected. Any other move returns 400. Body: status. This request uses the second candidate application so {{applicationId}} stays applied for the withdrawal example.

response.name: Update Application Status - 200 Success
Update Application Status - 400 Invalid Transition
Update Application Status - 403 Another Employer
Update Application Status - 404 Not Found

request.description: Applicant only. Withdraws an application while its status is applied. A shortlisted, rejected or hired application returns 400. Another candidate gets 403.

response.name: Withdraw Application - 200 Success
Withdraw Application - 400 Not In Applied Status
Withdraw Application - 403 Someone Else Application
Withdraw Application - 404 Not Found
